cairo_sightseeing.title: Giza Pyramids & Grand Egyptian Museum
cairo_sightseeing.base_hotel: Eileen Hotel (near Tahrir Square / Nile Corniche)
cairo_sightseeing.attractions: Pyramids of Giza, Grand Egyptian Museum
cairo_sightseeing.transport_notes: Eileen Hotel is near Tahrir Square — accessible from the museum area.
cairo_sightseeing.notes: Outbound stopover. Aegean A3932 arrives Aug 3 at 08:50. EgyptAir departs Aug 4 at 22:40 — full day available for sightseeing.

cairo_sightseeing.title: Islamic Cairo, Citadel, Khan el-Khalili & Coptic Cairo
cairo_sightseeing.attractions: Islamic Cairo, the Citadel, Khan el-Khalili bazaar, Coptic Cairo
cairo_sightseeing.transport_notes: Taxi needed between the Citadel and Coptic Cairo.
cairo_sightseeing.notes: Return stopover. EgyptAir arrives Aug 19 at 11:05. Aegean A3935 departs Aug 20 at 19:55 — full afternoon/evening available, plus morning Aug 20.

cairo_stopovers.title: Grand Egyptian Museum & Pyramids
cairo_stopovers.hotel_location_note: 21 Youssef El-Gendy St, Abdeen, Downtown Cairo — near Tahrir Square and Nile Corniche
cairo_stopovers.pois: Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM), Pyramids of Giza, Sphinx, Nile Corniche
cairo_stopovers.taxi_notes: Eileen Hotel is walking distance to Tahrir Square; taxi or Uber to Giza Pyramids (~30-45 min).
cairo_stopovers.description: Stopover 1 is a short Cairo window arriving morning Aug 3 and departing late evening Aug 4. Day 1 (Aug 3): rest after flight, evening Nile Corniche walk. Day 2 (Aug 4): full sightseeing — Grand Egyptian Museum in the morning, Pyramids of Giza + Sphinx in the afternoon. Return to hotel, then head to Cairo airport by 20:00 for the 22:40 EgyptAir flight to Dar es Salaam.

cairo_stopovers.title: Islamic Cairo, Citadel & Coptic Cairo
cairo_stopovers.pois: Islamic Cairo, the Citadel of Saladin, Khan el-Khalili bazaar, Coptic Cairo (Hanging Church, Ben Ezra Synagogue, St. Sergius Church)
cairo_stopovers.taxi_notes: Taxi or Uber needed for Citadel ↔ Coptic Cairo (not walking distance). Khan el-Khalili is walkable from Islamic Cairo mosques.
cairo_stopovers.description: Stopover 2 arrives Cairo 11:05 Aug 19. Day 1: check into Ramses Hilton, afternoon exploring Islamic Cairo and the Citadel, evening at Khan el-Khalili bazaar for shopping and dinner. Day 2: morning visit to Coptic Cairo (Hanging Church, Ben Ezra Synagogue, St. Sergius), afternoon free, head to airport by 17:00 for the 19:55 flight to Athens.

insurance_and_permits.instructions: Mandatory for all visitors to Zanzibar.
Carry International Driving Permit (IDP) + local permit. Screenshot of permit acceptable at police checkpoints. Police checkpoints are frequent.
insurance_and_permits.notes: Per driver, ~3 months validity. Vasileios holds IDP.

itinerary_days.title: Depart Athens — Arrive Cairo
itinerary_days.description: Fly Athens to Cairo on Aegean A3932. Cairo Stopover 1 begins. Check into Eileen Hotel, near Tahrir Square and Nile Corniche.
itinerary_days.afternoon_block: Check into Eileen Hotel. Rest and acclimate.
itinerary_days.evening_block: Explore Nile Corniche. Dinner in Downtown Cairo.

itinerary_days.title: Cairo — Grand Egyptian Museum & Pyramids
itinerary_days.description: Full-day sightseeing in Cairo. Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM) and Pyramids of Giza. Evening flight to Dar es Salaam.
itinerary_days.morning_block: Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM) — new facility, vast collection.
itinerary_days.afternoon_block: Pyramids of Giza + Sphinx. Depart for airport by 20:00.

itinerary_days.title: Arrive Dar es Salaam — Connect to Arusha
itinerary_days.description: Arrive Dar es Salaam 04:20. Transfer to domestic terminal. Precision Air TC144 to Arusha. Check into Serengeti Villa.
itinerary_days.morning_block: Arrive DAR 04:20. Transfer to domestic terminal. DAR→ARK Precision Air TC144, 10:50–12:00.
itinerary_days.afternoon_block: Arrive Arusha 12:00. Check into Serengeti Villa. Rest.
itinerary_days.evening_block: Dinner in Arusha. Prepare for safari. Contact: +255 757 757 928.

itinerary_days.title: Arusha — Rest & Preparation Day
itinerary_days.description: Full day in Arusha to recover from travel and prepare for the safari. Explore Arusha town, buy any last supplies.
itinerary_days.morning_block: Sleep in. Explore Arusha town centre and markets.
itinerary_days.afternoon_block: Visit Cultural Heritage Centre or Arusha Declaration Museum.
itinerary_days.evening_block: Pack for safari (Decathlon Forclaz gear). Confirm pickup with Richard (+255 763 222 293).

itinerary_days.title: Safari Day 1 — Tarangire National Park
itinerary_days.description: Suricata Safaris Day 1. Game drive in Tarangire NP — famous for elephants and baobab trees. Overnight at Twiga Camp Site (FB).
itinerary_days.morning_block: Pickup from Serengeti Villa. Drive to Tarangire NP. Game drive begins.
itinerary_days.afternoon_block: Full game drive — elephants, baobabs, lion, leopard, birdlife.
itinerary_days.evening_block: Camp at Twiga Camp Site, Tarangire. Full board dinner. Night sounds of the bush.

itinerary_days.title: Safari Day 2 — Lake Manyara National Park
itinerary_days.description: Suricata Safaris Day 2. Game drive in Lake Manyara NP — tree-climbing lions, flamingos, hippos. Overnight at Twiga Camp Site (FB).
itinerary_days.morning_block: Early game drive departure from Tarangire. Drive to Lake Manyara NP.
itinerary_days.afternoon_block: Full game drive — tree-climbing lions, soda lake, flamingos, hippo pools.
itinerary_days.evening_block: Camp at Twiga Camp Site, Lake Manyara. Full board dinner.

itinerary_days.title: Safari Day 3 — Ngorongoro Crater
itinerary_days.description: Suricata Safaris Day 3. Descend into Ngorongoro Crater for the ultimate game drive. Overnight at Jevas Hotel (HB). Bracelets bought at crater rim for Athina Mari (~35,000 TZS).
itinerary_days.morning_block: Early descent into Ngorongoro Crater (gate opens 06:00). Full game drive in the caldera.
itinerary_days.afternoon_block: Crater game drive continues. Exit by 18:00. Bracelets bought at crater rim for Athina Mari.
itinerary_days.evening_block: Jevas Hotel, Ngorongoro. Half board dinner. Warm layers needed — cold rim night.

itinerary_days.title: Return to Arusha — Kutoka Lodge
itinerary_days.description: Drive back to Arusha from Ngorongoro. Check into Kutoka Lodge. Rest after the 3-day safari.
itinerary_days.morning_block: Drive from Ngorongoro to Arusha. Scenic route via Karatu and Mto wa Mbu.
itinerary_days.afternoon_block: Check into Kutoka Lodge. Rest and laundry.
itinerary_days.evening_block: Dinner in Arusha. Reflect on safari highlights.

itinerary_days.title: Fly Arusha to Zanzibar — Stone Town
itinerary_days.description: Precision Air TC145 to Zanzibar. Check into Treasures of Zanzibar House in Stone Town. Explore Stone Town streets — photo opportunity.
itinerary_days.morning_block: ARK→ZNZ Precision Air TC145, 12:40–13:40. Soft bags preferred.
itinerary_days.afternoon_block: Check into Treasures of Zanzibar House. Explore Stone Town on foot.
itinerary_days.evening_block: Sunset at Forodhani Gardens night market. Try Zanzibar pizza.

itinerary_days.title: Stone Town Full Day
itinerary_days.description: Full day exploring Stone Town — UNESCO World Heritage Site. Slave Market, House of Wonders, Freddie Mercury's birthplace, spice shops.
itinerary_days.morning_block: Guided walking tour: Slave Market, Old Fort, House of Wonders.
itinerary_days.afternoon_block: Spice shops, Freddie Mercury house, narrow street exploration. Stone Town photo session.
itinerary_days.evening_block: Rooftop dinner. Live Taarab music if available.

itinerary_days.title: Transfer to Kiwengwa — Ayla Beach House
itinerary_days.description: Check out of Stone Town. Drive to Kiwengwa on Zanzibar's east coast. Check into Ayla Beach House for 4 nights. Beach time.
itinerary_days.morning_block: Check out of Treasures of Zanzibar House. Pick up rental car / arrange taxi.
itinerary_days.afternoon_block: Drive to Kiwengwa (east coast). Check into Ayla Beach House.
itinerary_days.evening_block: Beach walk. Dinner. Check tide table for tomorrow's swimming.

itinerary_days.title: Kiwengwa — Beach & Relaxation
itinerary_days.description: Relaxation day at Ayla Beach House. Beach, swimming (check tides), reading, and sunsets.
itinerary_days.morning_block: Beach time — check tide for swimming window.
itinerary_days.afternoon_block: Explore Kiwengwa village. Visit local cafes and beach bars.
itinerary_days.evening_block: Sunset dinner at Ayla Beach House or nearby restaurant.

itinerary_days.title: The Rock Restaurant & Beach Day
itinerary_days.description: Daytime beach and relaxation. Evening highlight: The Rock Restaurant 18:00–20:00. 2x Tropical Passion Fruit Cheesecake pre-ordered. Outdoor sunset seating.
itinerary_days.morning_block: Beach morning. Swimming and snorkelling (check tides).
itinerary_days.afternoon_block: Prepare for The Rock dinner. Enjoy beach and pool.
itinerary_days.evening_block: The Rock Restaurant, 18:00–20:00. 2 adults, $46 paid. 2x Tropical Passion Fruit Cheesecake. Sunset outdoor seating.

itinerary_days.title: Kiwengwa — Last Full Beach Day
itinerary_days.description: Final full day in Zanzibar. Beach, optional snorkelling or fishing trip. Pack for tomorrow's departure.
itinerary_days.morning_block: Optional snorkelling trip or reef walk (low tide).
itinerary_days.afternoon_block: Relaxation. Final beach swim. Pack luggage.
itinerary_days.evening_block: Farewell dinner in Kiwengwa. Confirm ferry tickets for tomorrow.

itinerary_days.title: Ferry to Dar es Salaam — Sunny Shore B&B
itinerary_days.description: Check out of Ayla Beach House. Drive to Stone Town ferry terminal. Ferry to Dar es Salaam. Check into Sunny Shore B&B. Begin Dar exploration.
itinerary_days.morning_block: Check out. Drive to Stone Town. Ferry from Zanzibar to Dar es Salaam.
itinerary_days.afternoon_block: Arrive Dar. Check into Sunny Shore B&B. Rest.
itinerary_days.evening_block: Explore Dar evening. Dinner. Plan Dar POIs for tomorrow.

itinerary_days.title: Dar es Salaam — Full Day Exploration
itinerary_days.description: Full day in Dar es Salaam. Visit Kivukoni Fish Market (early morning), National Museum, Kariakoo Market, Coco Beach. Option: Bongoyo Island day trip.
itinerary_days.morning_block: Kivukoni Fish Market (early morning). National Museum mid-morning.
itinerary_days.afternoon_block: Kariakoo Market exploration. Lunch in city centre. Option: Bongoyo Island day trip.
itinerary_days.evening_block: Coco Beach sunset. Final dinner in Dar. Prepare luggage for early flight.

itinerary_days.title: Fly Dar to Cairo — Cairo Stopover 2
itinerary_days.description: Early morning flight to Cairo. Cairo Stopover 2: Islamic Cairo, the Citadel, Khan el-Khalili bazaar, Coptic Cairo. Check into Ramses Hilton.
itinerary_days.afternoon_block: Check into Ramses Hilton. Islamic Cairo walk: Citadel, Sultan Hassan, Al-Azhar.
itinerary_days.evening_block: Khan el-Khalili bazaar. Dinner in Islamic Cairo.

itinerary_days.title: Cairo — Coptic Cairo & Fly Home
itinerary_days.description: Morning visit to Coptic Cairo. Afternoon free until evening flight. CAI→ATH Aegean A3935 19:55–22:00, ref ZZL22S. Arrive home.
itinerary_days.morning_block: Coptic Cairo: Hanging Church, Ben Ezra Synagogue, St. Sergius.
itinerary_days.afternoon_block: Free time. Last-minute shopping or Nile Corniche walk. Head to CAI airport by 17:00.
itinerary_days.evening_block: CAI→ATH Aegean A3935, 19:55–22:00, ref ZZL22S. Arrive Athens 22:00. Trip complete.

trip_rules.title: Warm Layers for Ngorongoro
trip_rules.detail: Ngorongoro Crater rim nights are cold. Bring warm layers: fleece, thermal base layer, beanie, gloves. Temperatures can drop significantly even in August.

trip_rules.title: Safari Clothing — Decathlon Forclaz
trip_rules.detail: Decathlon's Forclaz trekking line is recommended for safari clothing — lightweight, quick-dry fabrics in neutral colours. Avoid bright colours and dark blue (attracts tsetse flies).

trip_rules.title: DEET Insect Repellent
trip_rules.detail: DEET-based insect repellent is essential throughout the trip — safari parks, Zanzibar beaches, and Dar es Salaam. Apply regularly to ankles and wrists.

trip_rules.title: No Plastic Bags — Tanzania Ban
trip_rules.detail: Tanzania enforces a strict plastic bag ban. Do not pack plastic bags in any luggage. Use cloth, paper, or reusable alternatives. Fines apply at airports and park gates.

trip_rules.title: Precision Air — Soft Bags Only
trip_rules.detail: Precision Air flights TC144 (DAR→ARK) and TC145 (ARK→ZNZ) prefer soft bags due to luggage compartment restrictions. Pack accordingly or risk gate-check issues.

trip_rules.title: Zanzibar Driving Permit & IDP
trip_rules.detail: Zanzibar requires a local driving permit (~$15 per driver, ~3 months validity). Most rental companies arrange it with a license photo submitted 24h+ before arrival. Carry your International Driving Permit (IDP) alongside the local permit. Screenshots are acceptable for police checks.

trip_rules.title: Police Checkpoints — Zanzibar
trip_rules.detail: Police checkpoints are frequent on Zanzibar roads. Always carry your driving permits (IDP + local). Screenshots or photos of permits are generally accepted. Be polite and patient.

trip_rules.title: NCAA Speed Limits
trip_rules.detail: Ngorongoro Conservation Area speed limits: 50 kph on general roads, 25 kph inside the crater. Speed enforcement is strict — overspeeding penalty: TZS 118,000.

trip_rules.title: Crater Gate & Driving Hours
trip_rules.detail: Crater descent gates close at 16:00. All vehicles must exit the crater floor by 18:00. Park driving hours are 06:00–18:00. Plan game drives accordingly.

trip_rules.title: No Off-Road Driving
trip_rules.detail: Off-road driving is strictly prohibited in all NCAA parks. Stay on designated tracks at all times. Penalty for off-road driving or wrong parking: TZS 118,000.

trip_rules.title: Animal Sighting Etiquette
trip_rules.detail: Maximum 5 vehicles at any one wildlife sighting. Maintain at least 25 metres distance from animals. Do not honk, shout, or attempt to attract animal attention.

trip_rules.title: No Photographing Locals Outside Bomas
trip_rules.detail: Do not photograph local Maasai or other residents outside of designated Cultural Bomas. Always ask permission. Unauthorised photography can lead to fines or confiscation.

trip_rules.title: Zanzibar Tides & Swimming
trip_rules.detail: Zanzibar's east coast (Kiwengwa, where Ayla Beach House is located) experiences dramatic low tides — the ocean can recede hundreds of metres. Check daily tide tables for swimming windows. North coast (Nungwi) has more consistent water access.

trip_rules.title: August — Peak Safari Season
trip_rules.detail: August is peak season in northern Tanzania's safari circuit. The Great Wildebeest Migration is in the northern Serengeti corridor. Parks and accommodations book out months in advance. All bookings confirmed via Suricata Safaris.

trip_rules.title: EgyptAir CAI↔DAR Confirmation
trip_rules.detail: EgyptAir operates the Cairo ↔ Dar es Salaam legs. These are confirmed bookings — do not second-guess or replace with another carrier. Both legs are part of the €2,707 flights total.

trip_rules.title: Dar es Salaam — Ferry Arrival from Zanzibar
trip_rules.detail: Dar es Salaam arrival on Aug 17 is by ferry from Zanzibar (Stone Town). Ferry terminal connects to the city centre. Arrange transport from the terminal to Sunny Shore B&B in advance.
